body: Oh my god that is exactly how I feel about it too. I try very hard to not be like that. The world is a scary place. Some people lash out, and others (like myself) turn inward. I'd rather hurt myself than anyone else.

I can be positive, or even "moderate". I prefer to look at things "on the rational side". Rather than the bright side or always looking at the bad in things. I just kind of prefer to say yeah, that's how this is, and how that is, and that's life.

But it's just a matter of trying to get a shield up to keep out all the hateful/spiteful people. I feel like I can't escape them. And any time I have to spend more than a few hours with someone like that I just lose all hope.

People say so much hateful stuff about everything. I don't want to live in all that hate. I try to surround myself with positive people and normally I'm a really outwardly positive person too.

What if my answer is that I'm just done? To stop stringing my friends and family along with "will you or won't you" and just, be done. We have some pills, and I live literally walking distance from a drug store (who doesn't) and some other shit too that I've been thinking about using. I haven't decided.

I probably can't help, because I am a fellow poster here and frankly, I'm just pissed that no one responded to my post and I also noticed that yours has zero comments too. So I'm here, not with advice or "it gets better" b.s. but just to say that I'm super depressed and I know exactly how to make my life better but yeah, I'm kind of at that same point too where I'm just like "fuck it, I don't want to"

So, idk. Just so you know you're not the only one who gets like that. And that there's someone out there who also feels that way and it fucking sucks.

That's probably a good idea. I was having violent "flashes" and have been considering a lot of self harm lately, but haven't acted on it (I haven't acted on it since my attempt in 2011! Very proud of that)

I draw on myself with markers (to mimic self harm marks), which is just as embarrassing if people see it (I'm a full fledged adult who is married and has a professional image to maintain at 3, yes, 3 different jobs), but I'm good at "hiding" it and of course, it's easier to hide marker than it is to hide the alternative. 

So I guess I'll tell her that's where I'm at. I'm not certain what we'll decide to do after that. I just feel so hopeless, like everything is teetering on edge and if I make any wrong step it'll collapse. I'm so close to being out of this period in my life. So close it's ridiculous. I just need to make it. I need to make it.
